newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 3-mo bill yields same and 6-,9-,12-mo fall.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 3-mo bill yields same and 6-,9-,12-mo fall.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-month treasury bills were unchanged and six-, nine-, and 12-month yields slipped from the last sales on February 20 and February 21, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.

Three-month bills remained at 27.88 percent, six-month bills slipped to 32.89 percent from 33.33 percent, nine-month bills edged down to 35.56 percent from 35.69 percent and 12-month bills slipped to 38.48 percent from 38.63 percent.
Results of Tuesday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 25.00 million UAH 17.00 million UAH
Amount sold 25.00 million UAH 17.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 23.37 million UAH 15.89 million UAH
The central bank sold 250,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 227,089 were competitive and 22,911 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is February 27.
The results of Tuesday's six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 35.00 million UAH 17.00 million UAH
Amount sold 34.35 million UAH 17.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 29.51 million UAH 14.58 million UAH
The central bank sold 343,495 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 94,616 were competitive and 248,879 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for February 27.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 45.00 million UAH 25.00 million UAH
Amount sold 43.73 million UAH 24.69 million UAH
Actual amount raised 34.55 million UAH 19.49 million UAH
The central bank sold 437,351 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 233,539 were competitive and 203,812 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for February 27.
The results of 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 55.00 million UAH 35.00 million UAH
Amount sold 53.11 million UAH 15.93 million UAH
Actual amount raised 38.38 million UAH 11.49 million UAH
The central bank sold 531,096 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 207,297 were competitive and 323,799 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for February 27.
